pairs.preconditions: All dependencies accepted on current main; frozen predecessor interfaces; distinct isolated branches/worktrees and no shared locks/edit paths; neither edits root lockfile/provider port/router or allocated migration of the other; integration owner serializes acceptance.
pairs.merge_rule: Either independent task may merge first; remaining branch updates from current main and reruns affected contract/tenant/integration checks before acceptance.
